name: Classic Tuna Melt
description: A creamy, cheesy tuna melt with pickle, tomato, and red onion, grilled until golden brown.
recipeIngredient: 1/4 cup mayonnaise, plus more for the bread
2 (5-ounce) cans solid white tuna in water, drained
recipeInstructions: In a bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Add the tuna and mix to combine, then fold in the pickle.

Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Lightly spread one side of each bread slice with mayonnaise and place mayonnaise-side down on a work surface. Top 4 slices with one slice of Cheddar, then the tuna mixture, tomato, red onion, and a second slice of Cheddar. Add the remaining bread slices, mayonnaise-side up. Cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
